senses.gloss:
Dhrāji in the Rigveda and later denotes the ‘sweep’ of the wind, referring no doubt to the violent gales which often blow in India devastating the forests, and which figure in the descriptions of the Maruts, or storm gods.
Foot notes i. 164. 44; x. 97, 13; 136, 2.
Av. iii. 1, 5; Maitrāyaṇī Saṃhitā, i. 2, 17; iv. 9, 5 taittirīya Āraṇyaka, i 11, 19, etc.
Cf. Max Müller, Sacred Books of the East, xxxii. xxiii et seq.; Macdonell. Vedic Mythology, p. 79.
